content.title: Sykkuno Breaks Silence On Cheating Row, Admits 'I Was Unfaithful' In Joint Statement With Girlfriend
content.text: After days of silence and mounting allegations from all across the online streaming community, Sykkuno has finally spoken out about the serial-cheating allegations. In case you missed one of the internet's hottest controversies right now, HemomalVT shared a scathing expose last week about the streamer's alleged pattern of manipulating multiple women and forming relations while living with his long-time girlfriend. Now, in a detailed public statement, Sykkuno has admitted to cheating, lying about being single, and hurting multiple people, especially his girlfriend. Sykkuno admits to cheating in the first statement after HemomalVT's allegations On Thursday, April 16, 2026, Sykkuno released his public statement on X (formerly Twitter), addressing the allegations first raised by HemomalVT. The Twitch star acknowledged his actions and admitted that he had lied about being single, extending his apology to his girlfriend for putting her through the betrayal and pain. Sykkuno wrote: "I would like to apologize to everyone I have disappointed, most of all to my girlfriend. I am so sorry I put you through so much. I never want to make these mistakes again and hurt you and the people I care about... I was unfaithful, and I own and fully admit to that... I lied to people and told them I was single, which I know is not right. I'm sorry to all of the people that I hurt by doing this." However, while he admitted to being an unfaithful partner and telling people he was single, Sykkuno also mentioned seeing some "false accusations about me that are not true." The streamer pushed back on some of the more serious accusations circulating online, adding that he "cannot allow false accusations and such extreme labels" to define him. However, he didn't specify which accusations he was referring to. He also urged fans not to send hate toward anyone involved, noting that those who spoke out did so "from a place of hurt." Sykkuno explains his silence and announces a break from streaming In the same statement, Sykkuno explained his week-long silence before finally speaking out, given that so many new allegations were getting added to the controversy. The 34-year-old stated that both he and his girlfriend had already been working on their relationship before the public fallout, and the sudden exposure made things significantly more difficult for the couple. He shared: "My girlfriend and I didn't respond quickly because we were already working on our relationship and communication before this all happened. Having so much private information exposed to the public has made it incredibly difficult for us to heal together." Sykkuno concluded his statement by announcing a break from streaming and content creation for now, as he wants to focus on healing, growth, and self-repair. He shared, "I will be taking a break from streaming and the internet to better myself." Continue reading below Sykkuno's girlfriend speaks up: "It feels like a nightmare" The community has been especially worried about Sykkuno's girlfriend's mental state amid the explosive public revelations about their private life. The streamer's girlfriend has been a long-kept secret from the public eye, and it looks like she wants things to stay that way. Sykkuno's words were followed by an emotional statement from his girlfriend, who chose to share her side publicly for the first time. Describing the situation as deeply painful, she wrote: "It's been extremely heartbreaking to learn everything I know now, and going through this has been one of the hardest things I've ever been put through in my life... I've been tossed around from all sides, me and my reality have been continuously shattered... Though no matter how broken I am, I never wanted this to be public... I didn't want this... I don't believe my feelings were considered in this situation at all." She also revealed that she had not been contacted by others involved after the allegations surfaced, saying her feelings were overlooked despite the situation directly affecting her. Still, she surprisingly confirmed she has chosen to stay and work on the relationship, saying, "I don’t think they are irredeemable… I believe this will be a step in the right direction." See Sykkuno's post here. What was the controversy about? On April 10, 2026, HemomalVT released a viral document that said Sykkuno was in a secret long-term relationship while also dating several women. The claims described a pattern of rapid emotional intimacy, private conversations, and alleged dishonesty about his relationship status. Following the initial post, other streamers, including his ex-girlfriend, Lena, shared their own experiences. Even one of his best friends, Valkyrae, addressed the controversy.
